name: std::basic_ifstream<CharT,Traits>::swap
intro:
Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.

This is done by calling basic_istream<CharT, Traits>::swap(other) and rdbuf()->swap(other.rdbuf()).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

 stream to exchange the state with

summary: Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.
